source_text: 67 MINISTRIS. Ministerium Christi zacones exercite casti; Idcirco ministri facite praecepta magistri. Nolite fugere personam iudicis aequi, Integrate locum uestrum per omnia docti. Susum intendentes, semper Deo summo deuoti Tota Deo reddite inlaesa sacra, ministri. Rebus in diuersis exemplum date parati; Inclinate caput uestrum pastoribus ipsi: Sic fiet, ut Christo possitis <esse> probati.
pass_a_gloss: Ministerium Christi… casti; praecepta magistri. Deo summo deuoti; Inlaesa sacra. Inclinate… pastoribus → Christo… probati.
pass_b_english: Exercise Christ’s ministry, chaste deacons; therefore, ministers, do the Master’s precepts. Do not flee the person of a fair judge; keep your place whole, taught in all things. Looking upward, always devoted to the highest God, render to God all the holy things unhurt, ministers. In diverse matters give example, ready; yourselves bow your head to the pastors: so it will be that you can be proven in Christ.

choices.choose: devote holy things unhurt to God
bow to pastors — proven in Christ
